verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents on-robot data capture: `ros2 bag` records and plays rosbags, and a Python API lets your own nodes write sensor or synthetic data to bags. A long-time user also confirms data bagging comes 'for free'. The evidence shows no cloud sync or upload, and QoS settings tune node-to-node DDS links rather than bandwidth-aware cloud sync policies, so only the capture half is delivered. Missing for 10: cloud upload/sync mechanism, bandwidth-aware or prioritized sync policies, offline buffering/retry to cloud, independent corroboration of an end-to-end pipeline.
